notes: empty function: the whole body is ret (empty virtual methods, no-op callbacks); excludes members with unlisted code in their padding
returns zero: xor eax, eax; ret (false, null, 0); excludes members with unlisted code in their padding
returns a constant: mov eax, imm32; ret, zero-extended to rax; excludes members with unlisted code in their padding
64-bit field getter: mov rax, [rdi+K]; ret, one replacement per offset; negative offsets excluded
32-bit field getter: mov eax, [rdi+K]; ret, zero-extended to rax; negative offsets excluded
16-bit field getter: movzx eax, word [rdi+K]; ret; negative offsets excluded
8-bit field getter: movzx eax, byte [rdi+K]; ret (mov al, [rdi+K] keeps rax's upper bytes and is excluded)
member or base address: lea rax, [rdi+K]; ret, reads no memory
forwarding thunk: mov rax, [rdi]; mov rax, [rax+K]; jmp rax, the arguments passed on as they came, one replacement per slot offset
forwarding thunk: mov rax, [rdi]; jmp [rax+K], the arguments passed on as they came, one replacement per slot offset
forwarding thunk: slot K of the object's virtual table with the third argument set to 1, the others as they came
forwarding thunk: slot 0x68 of the object's virtual table with 0xe8 added to the second argument (a part of the object it points at)
base thunk: rdi - 0x20 (the whole object, from a base 0x20 into it), then slot 0x68 of its virtual table with 0xe8 added to the second argument
forwarding thunk: slot K of the virtual table of the object the pointer at rdi+0x10 points at, which becomes the first argument
forwarding thunk: slot K of the object at rdi+8, with the dword rsi points at as its second argument
call slot 0x40 of the object at rdi+8 with the constant K, return its result; one replacement per K
store the pointer at rdi+0x20 through rsi, then tail-call slot 8 of the object it points at
null-checked forwarding thunk: tail-call slot K of the object's virtual table, or return 0x25 when the object is null
forwarding thunk: jmp [slot K] of the object the pointer at rdi+8 points at, which becomes the first argument
forwarding thunk: jmp [slot K] of the object the pointer at rdi+0x10 points at, which becomes the first argument
forwarding thunk: slot K of the virtual table of the object the pointer at rdi+8 points at, which becomes the first argument
forwarding thunk: tail-call slot K (a 32-bit offset) of the object's virtual table with the same arguments
forwarding thunk: jmp [slot K] (a 32-bit offset) of the object's virtual table with the same arguments
the first argument is a table of functions: jmp [entry K] with the second argument as its first (and still its second), the others as they came
first-field getter: mov rax, [rdi]; ret
first 32-bit field getter: mov eax, [rdi]; ret, zero-extended to rax
64-bit field setter: mov [rdi+K], rsi; ret; leaves rax
32-bit field setter: mov [rdi+K], esi; ret; leaves rax
16-bit field setter: mov [rdi+K], si; ret; leaves rax
8-bit field setter: mov [rdi+K], sil; ret; leaves rax
first-field setter: mov [rdi], rsi; ret; leaves rax
first 32-bit field setter: mov [rdi], esi; ret; leaves rax
identity: mov rax, rdi; ret
returns the second argument: mov rax, rsi; ret
returns 0.0f: vxorps xmm0, xmm0, xmm0; ret (all of xmm0 zero)
